typography.font_family: Tajawal, Cairo, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, sans-serif

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white

grids.pricing_cards: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8 max-w-5xl mx-auto
grids.trust_bar: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto

layouts.page_container: dark bg-slate-950 text-slate-50 min-h-screen py-16 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8
layouts.hero_section: text-center mb-16 space-y-6 flex flex-col items-center
layouts.status_card: max-w-4xl mx-auto mt-12 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-xl shadow-amber-900/5
layouts.help_card: max-w-2xl mx-auto mt-24 bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 to-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-8 text-center

visual_enhancers.card_glow: relative before:absolute before:inset-0 before:-z-10 before:bg-gradient-to-br before:from-amber-500/10 before:to-transparent before:blur-xl before:rounded-3xl

components.hero_badge: inline-flex items-center px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm font-medium bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20 mb-6
components.primary_button: w-full py-4 px-6 rounded-xl font-bold bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 transition-colors shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20
components.secondary_button: w-full py-4 px-6 rounded-xl font-bold bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white border border-slate-700 transition-colors
components.status_badge: px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
components.trust_item: flex flex-col items-center text-center space-y-3 p-4 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 transition-colors

instructions_to_main_agent: Wrap the entire page content in a top-level `div` with `className='dark bg-slate-950 min-h-screen font-sans'` and `dir='rtl'` to encapsulate the dark theme independently from the light-theme app shell.
Ensure all predefined data-testids are strictly preserved exactly as provided in the problem statement.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide-react for trust bar and feature list icons (e.g., CheckCircle, ShieldCheck, Lifebuoy, Lightning).
For the 8-tile metadata grid in the status card, use a subtle 1px border grid pattern (border-slate-800/50) with inner padding for each cell to resemble a technical financial dashboard.
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` or `<input type='date'>`. Use provided shadcn components if needed, but this page is mostly display and buttons.
Keep BOTH pricing cards visible. Conditionally render the 'الخطة الحالية / Current Plan' badge and 'يرجى إلغاء الخطة الحالية أولاً' note based on the active plan state.
The Annual plan card MUST feature the 'الأكثر توفيراً' badge, the $299 strikethrough, and the $99/year text clearly styled to highlight the discount.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and major layout sections as per requirement.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts except for the hero section.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (except the explicitly requested 🚀 in the hero badge).
Apply specific transitions for interactive elements (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform). DO NOT use `transition-all`.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-xl or pill-shaped) with interaction animations.
Do not alter the global `index.css` to center text universally.

accessibility.aria_roles: Ensure all buttons have clear aria-labels if text is ambiguous. Pricing cards should use section tags with aria-labelledby.
accessibility.contrast: Maintain APCA contrast ratio. Text-slate-400 on bg-slate-950 is generally compliant for small text, but use text-slate-300 for body.

media.instructions: Use the hero_background image as an ultra-low opacity (e.g., opacity-5) absolute background layer with a radial gradient mask to add subtle texture to the dark canvas, avoiding flatness. Do not let it interfere with text legibility.
